mcp_coverage_note: rustre-mcp.exe does not expose any tools covering the rustre-symb crate symbolic-execution surface (SymExpr constructors, simplifier, SymMemory, PathConstraint, SymbolicState). MCP server only references rustre-symbols-pdb (a different crate) and analysis_trace_data_flow_path (rustre-analysis-dataflow). The symbolic execution core is an internal library API consumed by other crates, not surfaced via MCP.
